credits.title: Trinidad
credits.overview: Trinidad flees persecution in Spain for the wild west. Along the way, she earns renown for her weapons skills but also becomes a target of enemies, such as the widow Bronson.

credits.title: The Heaven of Animals
credits.overview: A fleeting, magical relationship blossoms when Diego, abandoned by his wife, meets Amanda, a fanciful teen amputee trampoline jumper. A meek mermaid and a disoriented, free-falling man's unlikely bond.

credits.title: Rita
credits.overview: Set in 1984 during the UEFA Euro craze, 7-year-old Rita wants to go to the beach. Unfortunately, her father makes watching the match his priority, and what her father says goes. For the first time in her life, Rita sees and realises that her home is not safe, especially for her mother.

credits.title: When the cicades fall silent
credits.overview: Sara, a 23-year-old girl, has just found out she is pregnant. It is summer in a small village in the Andalusian mountains, and she lives with her younger sister, whom she has been taking care of since they were left alone.
